responsibility: Runtime adapter for the NeXT/Apple Objective-C ABI 2 used by modern 64-bit Darwin targets. It provides objc_runtime_hooks implementations for ABI-2 metadata templates and layouts, selector/message reference objects and fixup calls, class/category/protocol/property emission, constant-string handling, and Objective-C exception integration via ABI-2 catch/throw runtime helpers and generated OBJC_EHTYPE descriptors, producing metadata intended to match Apple’s modern runtime conventions.
